FIELDNOTES / AUTISM & ACCESSIBILITY

A CLASSROOM DEMONSTRATION

Same café.
Different conditions.

Explore how the environment changes a simple task.
A teaching example, not a simulation of being autistic. Experiences and support preferences vary.

Corner Café

A familiar starting point

YOUR TASK

Order a small iced latte with oat milk.

1. Choose a drink.   2. Choose milk and size.   3. Check the written order.

BARISTA

“Choose your drink, milk, and size. Take the time you need.”

Drink

This is a practice task. Nothing is purchased.

TODAY AT THE CAFÉ
New pastries at the counter.

CHANGE THE CONDITIONS

Start with the task

Read the order, then make your selection. There is no timer or score.

Optional: change the order during the task.

Support changes the environment.

Clear language, a written plan, and fewer competing notices. Ask which adjustments help the person.

PAUSE & DISCUSS

What changed about the task?

AttentionWhat competed with the order?

CommunicationWhich information was missing?

SupportWhat made your next step clearer?

Repeating the task creates practice effects. This demo does not measure autism, overload, or treatment benefit.

Sources & limits of the demonstration

The café, wording, notices, and sound are authored teaching examples. They have not been validated as a model of autistic perception. Autistic experiences include sensory seeking, reduced sensitivity, increased sensitivity, and variation across situations. This demo shows only selected environmental barriers.

  • National Autistic Society: Autism and sensory processing — sensory differences, individual variation, and support.
  • National Autistic Society: Autism and communication — communication differences and accessible communication.
  • Autistic Self Advocacy Network: About Autism — further reading from an autistic-led organization.
  • American Psychiatric Association. (2022). DSM-5-TR, Autism Spectrum Disorder — conceptual links to sensory responses and responses to change, not validation of this activity.

Sources reviewed September 2026. No personal data, clinical scores, microphone recording, or real orders are collected. Audio starts only when you turn it on. Stop & quiet or Escape removes notices and stops audio.

中文主持講稿 · 2–3 分鐘

開場｜約 20 秒

「這不是讓大家在兩分鐘內體驗自閉症，而是透過一個點餐任務，觀察環境和溝通方式怎麼影響完成事情。自閉症者的感受並不相同，這個示範只涵蓋部分可能遇到的障礙。大家可以選擇只觀看，聲音也不需要開啟。」

01 先完成任務｜約 30 秒

請觀眾讀出訂單，再選飲料、牛奶與大小。不計時、不排名。這裡先讓大家知道原本要完成什麼。

02 加入環境負擔｜約 40 秒

切換 Add barriers，逐項指出背景通知、含糊指示、文字訂單隱藏的差異。聲音由主持人或參與者主動選擇，低音量即可；也可以全程靜音。選按「Introduce an unavailable item」展示臨時變動。「現在增加的負擔來自哪裡？你需要店員補充哪些資訊？」觀眾可隨時按 Ask for clear instructions。

03 加入支持｜約 40 秒

切換 Add support，保留相同點餐任務與品項變動，觀察文字訂單、步驟、明確替代方案與較少干擾帶來的差別。「這次我們改變了環境，並沒有要求參與者更努力忍耐。」

收束｜約 30 秒

「有些人會需要降低刺激，有些人可能需要更多刺激或不同支持，因此實際調整需要詢問當事人。我們不能用這個任務的表現判斷 ASD，也不能把重複練習後變快當作治療效果。」可以回扣 DSM 的 B4 感覺反應、B2 對變動的適應，以及溝通支持。不要把含糊指示任務直接當成 A1–A3 的測驗。
